CIRCUIT
10m
AMRAP #1
10 Wall Ball Burpee
10 Wall Ball Sit Up
12 Wall Ball Alt Jump Lunge
20 Wall Ball Mt Climbers

CIRCUIT
10m
AMRAP #2
12 Kneeling Rotational Wall Ball Throw
15 Wall Ball Squat Toss
12 Wall Ball Alt Kneeling Roll Out

"Circuit"
1. Wall Ball Burpee 1 set of 10 reps
* AMRAP #1, 10 minute window of time
2. Wall Ball Sit Up 1 set of 10 reps
3. Wall Ball Alt Jump Lunge 1 set of 12 reps
4. Wall Ball Mt Climbers 1 set of 20 reps
5. Kneeling Rotational Wall Ball Throw 1 set of 12 reps
* AMRAP #2, 10 minute window of time
6. Wall Ball Squat Toss 1 set of 15 reps
7. Wall Ball Alt Kneeling Roll Out 1 set of 12 reps
